description: Absolutely amazing value in beautiful Sausalito! Set in the quiet hills of Sausalito's Nevada Valley, this updated, turn-key condo at The Roc offers a peaceful retreat with peekaboo bay views and tree-lined surroundings. The unit features new paint, carpet, stove, and a remodeled walk-in shower, plus crown molding throughout and generous closet space including an extra storage closet in the garage. The private deck and bedroom overlook trees lit with evening spotlights, creating a warm and calming ambiance.  Includes one garage parking space with a commercial-grade bike rack. The condo has been lovingly owned for over 20 years.  The Roc is known for its heated pool with stunning Mt. Tam views, two elevators, and expansive water views from the entrance. Located just 4 miles from the Golden Gate Bridge and 2 miles from the ferry, the neighborhood offers easy access to trails, houseboats, Remington Dog Park, MLK Park, and top local spots like Mollie Stone's, Bay Model, Fish, and Le Garage.  Ideal for those seeking a quiet, community-oriented setting with quick access to Southern Marin's best.
